county_match: Case-insensitive alphanumeric normalization of CMS County/Parish against the validated county_name by five-digit FIPS; unmatched facility labels fail.
identification: Two separate measures from the broader study; no composite or reproduction of historical POS findings.

inputs.notes: Official Pennsylvania-relative 2022 county file; 67 counties; preserve RPL_THEMES and its approved 100-times transformation.
Extracted only the requested hospital general information table from the verified official snapshot archive.
inputs.provider: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Provider Data Catalog

transformations.hospital_count: Count distinct CMS Facility ID values by matched Pennsylvania county; include every Hospital Type present in the snapshot.
transformations.svi_score_0_100: 100 * official Pennsylvania-relative RPL_THEMES; preserved from the validated export without recalculation.
